REPORTING AND AUTOMATION FOR SMALL BUSINESSES

Turn your weekly exports into a report you can use.

A reusable report from the CSV files you already export. See weekly sales totals and overdue balances without rebuilding the spreadsheet each time.

A focused first pilot

  • Up to two CSV exports from one existing workflow.
  • One agreed report with up to five measures.
  • A reusable local script, report output and short run guide.
  • A demonstration with synthetic data, then acceptance using a customer-approved sample.
  • One revision against the agreed scope and a 14-day period to report defects in that scope.

Runs on the customer's existing computer. Live integrations, AI usage, hosting and ongoing support are separately scoped.

One pilot at a time

How it works

1. Confirm the report

Agree the input columns, reporting period and what a correct result looks like. Use anonymised samples first.

2. Check a working demonstration

Review the totals, missing fields and overdue balances. No bank connection or write access is required.

3. Reuse the report

Export fresh files, run the script, and open the result. The customer keeps the script and run guide.
